verses.text: This is what the LORD says: "Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. So what kind of house could you build for me? Where would my resting place be?

My hand made all these things, and that is how they all came to be," says the LORD. "But this is the one I look to with favor: the one who is humble and sorry for their sins, and who trembles at my word.

But whoever sacrifices a bull is like one who kills a person. Whoever offers a lamb is like one who breaks a dog's neck. Whoever brings a grain offering is like one who offers pig's blood. Whoever burns incense is like one who worships an idol. They have chosen their own ways, and they delight in their disgusting practices.

So I will choose harsh treatment for them and bring on them what they fear most. For when I called, no one answered. When I spoke, no one listened. They did what is evil in my eyes and chose what does not please me."

Listen to the word of the LORD, you who tremble at his word: "Your own people hate you and throw you out because of my name. They have said, 'Let the LORD be glorified, so we can see your joy!' But they are the ones who will be put to shame.
Listen! There is an uproar in the city! There is a noise from the temple! It is the sound of the LORD paying back his enemies what they deserve.
Before she went into labor, she gave birth. Before the pains came, she delivered a son.

Who has ever heard of such a thing? Who has ever seen anything like this? Can a country be born in one day? Can a nation be born in a moment? Yet as soon as Zion went into labor, she gave birth to her children.
Would I bring a baby to the moment of birth and not let it be born?" says the LORD. "Would I, who let mothers give birth, close up the womb?" says your God.
"Celebrate with Jerusalem and be glad for her, all you who love her. Rejoice greatly with her, all you who mourn over her.
For you will nurse and be satisfied at her comforting breasts. You will drink deeply and enjoy her overflowing glory."
For this is what the LORD says: "I will make peace flow to her like a river, and the wealth of the nations like a flooding stream. You will nurse and be carried on her hip and bounced on her knees.
As a mother comforts her child, so I will comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem."
When you see this, your heart will be glad, and your body will grow strong like new grass. The power of the LORD will be shown to his servants, but his anger will be shown to his enemies.
Look, the LORD is coming with fire, and his chariots are like a whirlwind. He will bring his anger with fury, and his warning with flames of fire.
For with fire and with his sword the LORD will judge all people, and many will be killed by the LORD.

"Those who make themselves holy and pure to go into the gardens, following one who leads them in the middle, who eat pork, rats, and other disgusting things, will all come to an end together," says the LORD.
"For I know what they do and what they think. The time is coming when I will gather all nations and languages, and they will come and see my glory.

I will set a sign among them. I will send some of those who survive to the nations: to Tarshish, to Pul, and to Lud, famous for their archers, to Tubal and Greece, and to the faraway islands that have not heard of my fame or seen my glory. They will announce my glory among the nations.

They will bring all your brothers and sisters from all the nations to my holy mountain in Jerusalem as an offering to the LORD. They will come on horses, in chariots and wagons, and on mules and camels," says the LORD. "They will come just as the Israelites bring their grain offerings to the house of the LORD in clean containers.
And I will choose some of them to be priests and Levites," says the LORD.
"Just as the new heavens and the new earth that I am making will last before me," says the LORD, "so your descendants and your name will last.
From one New Moon to the next, and from one Sabbath to the next, all people will come and bow down before me," says the LORD.

"They will go out and look at the dead bodies of those who rebelled against me. The worms that eat them will never die, and the fire that burns them will never go out. All people will be disgusted by them."
